subject.title: Dashboard: preview widget — live URL embed, dev-server preview, browser-backed inspection

question: What trusted preview boundary should OpenClaw support for live URL embeds, agent-owned dev servers, and browser-backed console/network/screenshot inspection in the dashboard?
rationale: The request crosses browser-state, process-control, and operator-visibility security boundaries, while the dashboard widget substrate is still open PR work rather than current main.

options.title: Read-Only Preview First
options.body: Build embed, reload, and viewport controls first, and require separate approval for dev-server spawning plus console/network/screenshot inspection.

options.title: Wait For Dashboard Stack
options.body: Defer implementation until the Wave 1 dashboard PRs land or are rejected, then target the final widget/store APIs.

options.title: Fold Into Browser Preview Tracker
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/27574 as the canonical trust-model discussion if maintainers prefer one browser-preview thread.

recommendation.title: Read-Only Preview First
recommendation.body: Build embed, reload, and viewport controls first, and require separate approval for dev-server spawning plus console/network/screenshot inspection.

likelyOwner.reason: The plugin-tab and browser-control history makes steipete the strongest routing candidate for the security/product boundary decision.
